mathematical_scope: Floating negative-sign normalized Fourier covariance control and first-column comparison for one sampled unitary Green stage. The sign convention is consistent with np.fft.fft and D=exp(-2πik/N); it intentionally differs from the modular positive-sign control.
input_and_guard_coverage: No explicit n>0/domain guard. No acceptance assertions: four residual/error values are returned for inspection. Fixed Frobenius normalization by sqrt(n) is meaningful on positive sizes but not itself a tolerance.
cost_and_scaling: Builds dense S,Z,F. A@Z uses a dense matrix multiplication even though Z is a permutation, so covariance evaluation can be O(N³); storage O(N²). No fast candidate algorithm is established.
test_evidence: Three main cases N32,64,128; no randomized sweep or condition-dependent acceptance. Phase12 tests include a related independent source-level covariance test. Not run here.
dependency_identity: Unreviewed-body identity unitary_mixer aff6a16c… plus unpinned NumPy.

findings.finding: A zero process exit carries no pass/fail meaning; the module has no threshold assertions. Numeric outputs need independent interpretation.
Preserve the negative-sign normalized convention when comparing against positive-sign unnormalized finite-field reports.

acceptance_boundary: Accept only as numerical finite-instance falsification-control design, not an exact proof or a passing-run attestation.
